paper_id: Adapter-based Selective Knowledge Distillation for Federated Multi-domain Meeting Summarization
title: Adapter-based Selective Knowledge Distillation for Federated Multi-domain Meeting Summarization
motivation: 会议数据高度敏感,无法集中收集,现有集中式方法无法满足真实场景需求
problem_framing: 联邦学习下非IID数据导致领域漂移,且预训练大模型参数交换带来高通信开销
key_insight: 用全局适配器传递服务器知识,用本地适配器保留本地领域,同时用熵值过滤不确定的全局知识
method_signature: ADAFEDSELECTKD:全局-本地适配器+选择性知识蒸馏
evaluation_criteria: ROUGE-1/2/L自动评估+人工评价,与集中式训练方法对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 数据集变异性不足,模拟环境缺乏不确定性,真实场景仍存差距
evidence_for_taste: global knowledge with high entropy has no confidence
the higher the entropy, the more uncertain the knowledge
the gold standard meeting summaries continue to demonstrate advantages
impossible for local models to focus on their own domain
immaturity parameters provided by the server inevitably introduce useless information
thinking_moves: 将联邦学习通信开销问题重新定义为参数高效微调问题
用熵值作为不确定性的代理指标来过滤蒸馏知识
分离全局适配器和本地适配器以解耦全局知识与领域专注
通过消融实验揭示名词和动词是知识蒸馏的核心学习对象
cites_own_work: Dialogue discourse-aware graph model and data augmentation for meeting summarization (IJCAI 2020)
A survey on dialogue summarization: Recent advances and new frontiers (2021)
